question: A 37-year-old woman with an extensive ulcerative colitis has a severe outbreak where treatment with prednisone is started at a dose of 1 mg / kg. After a week of treatment, the patient does not show improvement. What is the next therapeutic measure to perform?

options.opa: Subtotal colectomy of urgency and in a second time proctectomy and ileoanal reservoir.
options.opb: Associate an immunosuppressant such as azathioprine.
options.opc: Associate mesalazine in doses of 4 grams per day oral and rectal triamcinolone 1 application every 12 hours
options.ope: Treatment with etanercept (an anti-TNFa antibody) should be assessed.
